description: Issue #148: 'the same answer' means two CONSECUTIVE turns. #201's scope gate names the same two paths, then a turn that is not a scope failure at all (exit 21, work-evidence found nothing) intervenes and is nudged as before, then the same two paths come back. The comparison resets across that turn, so the repeat is only recognised on turns 3 and 4 — 4 sends under --max-turns 6, not 3. A guard that kept comparing across the intervening turn would cut a worker off one turn earlier than the rule it is written from.
